name: sloppish-to-english
description: Rewrites Codex response drafts in plain English before they are shown.

interface.shortDescription: Plain-English rewrite before Codex replies appear.
interface.longDescription: Uses a bundled local tool and a separate, read-only Codex CLI call to rewrite each completed response draft in plain language before the assistant message is shown. Translator failures fall back to the original draft.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain how the plain-language rewrite plugin works.
